class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Ensure files is a list and filter out empty/None values
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        # Filter out None/empty values
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        # Build endpoints inject caller-controlled file references directly into
        # ChatInput. Resolve and validate local references before the Message can
        # later read them while constructing model attachment content.
        if files:
            settings_service = get_settings_service()
            storage_type = getattr(getattr(settings_service, "settings", None), "storage_type", "local")
            # The storage factory falls back to local storage for unsupported
            # values, so only the explicitly configured S3 backend may bypass
            # filesystem containment.
            if str(storage_type).lower() != "s3" and is_local_file_access_restricted():
                scope_ids = list(component_file_access_scopes(self))
                # Public executions replace graph.flow_id with a per-visitor
                # virtual ID. Only the server-populated source provenance may
                # restore the already-validated public attachment namespace.
                source_flow_id = getattr(self.graph, "source_flow_id", None)
                if source_flow_id:
                    scope_ids.append(source_flow_id)
                for file_path in get_file_paths(files):
                    enforce_local_file_access(file_path, scope_ids=scope_ids)

        session_id = self.session_id or self.graph.session_id or ""
        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
            context_id=self.context_id,
            files=files,
        )
        if session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

    def update_build_config(
        self, build_config: dict[str, Any], field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        flow_id = _resolve_flow_id(self, build_config)
        src_mode = (
            field_value
            if field_name == "source_mode" and isinstance(field_value, str)
            else build_config.get("source_mode", {}).get("value")
            or getattr(self, "source_mode", "Text Input")
        ).strip()
        rmode = (
            field_value
            if field_name == "redact_mode" and isinstance(field_value, str)
            else build_config.get("redact_mode", {}).get("value")
            or getattr(self, "redact_mode", "redact")
        ).strip().lower()

        is_stage = src_mode.startswith("Stage ")
        is_table = src_mode == "Table Column"
        if "input_text" in build_config:
            build_config["input_text"]["show"] = src_mode == "Text Input"
        if "allowlist_values" in build_config:
            build_config["allowlist_values"]["show"] = rmode == "detect_with_allowlist"
        if "stage_selector" in build_config:
            build_config["stage_selector"]["show"] = is_stage
        if "stage_file_path" in build_config:
            build_config["stage_file_path"]["show"] = is_stage
        if "table_fqn" in build_config:
            build_config["table_fqn"]["show"] = is_table
        if "text_column" in build_config:
            build_config["text_column"]["show"] = is_table
        if "max_rows" in build_config:
            build_config["max_rows"]["show"] = is_table

        if is_stage:
            stg_resp = LIVE_BRIDGE.list_stages_for_context(flow_id=flow_id)
            stg_items = stg_resp.get("stages") or []
            stg_opts = [
                str(s.get("stage_fqn") or f"@{s.get('fqn')}")
                for s in stg_items
                if isinstance(s, dict) and (s.get("stage_fqn") or s.get("fqn"))
            ]
            if not stg_opts:
                stg_opts = ["@SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW.CORE.SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW_STAGE"]
            if "stage_selector" in build_config:
                build_config["stage_selector"]["options"] = stg_opts
                cur_stg = build_config["stage_selector"].get("value") or stg_opts[0]
            else:
                cur_stg = stg_opts[0]
            if field_name == "stage_selector" and isinstance(field_value, str) and field_value.strip():
                cur_stg = field_value.strip()

            files_resp = LIVE_BRIDGE.list_stage_files(cur_stg)
            media_filter = "Audio" if "Audio" in src_mode else "Documents"
            file_opts = filter_stage_files_for_function(
                files_resp.get("files") or [],
                ai_function="AI_REDACT",
                media_type_filter=media_filter,
            )
            if "stage_file_path" in build_config:
                build_config["stage_file_path"]["options"] = file_opts

        return build_config

    def _build_plan(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return SnowflakeAIRedactEngine.build_sql(
            input_text=getattr(self, "input_text", "") or "",
            mode=getattr(self, "redact_mode", "redact") or "redact",
            categories=getattr(self, "pii_categories", "ALL"),
            return_error_details=bool(getattr(self, "return_error_details", True)),
            auto_chunk_long_text=bool(getattr(self, "auto_chunk_long_text", False)),
            chunk_size=int(getattr(self, "chunk_size", 1000) or 1000),
            source_mode=getattr(self, "source_mode", "Text Input") or "Text Input",
            stage_selector=getattr(self, "stage_selector", "") or "",
            stage_file_path=getattr(self, "stage_file_path", "") or "",
            table_fqn=getattr(self, "table_fqn", "") or "",
            text_column=getattr(self, "text_column", "") or "",
            max_rows=int(getattr(self, "max_rows", 100) or 100),
        )

    def _build_sql(self) -> str:
        return str(self._build_plan()["sql"])

    def run_ai_redact(self) -> Message:
        plan = self._build_plan()
        # PASSO3: `session_setup_sql` (ALTER SESSION) is reported, not executed: every SQL API request is its
        # own session, so it never affected the next statement, and ALTER SESSION is not a flow-context statement.

        stmt = str(plan["sql"])
        res = _flow_component_execute_sql(stmt)
        if not res.get("ok"):
            if bool(getattr(self, "return_error_details", True)):
                return Message(
                    text=json.dumps(
                        {
                            "value": None,
                            "error": res.get("message") or "AI_REDACT execution failed",
                        },
                        indent=2,
                    )
                )
            raise ValueError(res.get("message", "AI_REDACT execution failed"))

        rows = res.get("rows", [])
        first_row = rows[0] if rows and isinstance(rows[0], dict) else {}
        raw_val = (
            first_row.get("RESULT")
            if "RESULT" in first_row
            else first_row.get("value")
            if "value" in first_row
            else first_row.get("VALUE")
            if "VALUE" in first_row
            else first_row.get("result")
            if "result" in first_row
            else ""
        )
        raw_err = first_row.get("error") or first_row.get("ERROR") or first_row.get("ERRORS")

        mode = str(plan.get("mode") or "redact")
        txt_in = str(getattr(self, "input_text", "") or "")

        if mode in ("detect", "detect_with_allowlist"):
            # BUG-LLMOP-009: parse the real detect output; fail closed (never forward the original text,
            # never invent spans). The original-text spans stay local; outputs carry masked values only.
            if raw_err:
                raise ValueError(f"AI_REDACT {mode} failed: {raw_err}")
            try:
                spans = SnowflakeAIRedactEngine.parse_detect_spans(raw_val, txt_in)
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"AI_REDACT {mode} result could not be parsed safely: {exc}") from exc
            spliced = SnowflakeAIRedactEngine.apply_allowlist_splicing(
                input_text=txt_in,
                spans=spans,
                allowlist=(getattr(self, "allowlist_values", "") or "") if mode == "detect_with_allowlist" else "",
            )
            masked = SnowflakeAIRedactEngine.masked_spans(sorted(spliced["redacted_spans"], key=lambda sp: sp["start"]))
            safe_trace = mask_ai_redact_detect_spans(
                {"input_text": spliced["redacted_text"], "spans": masked},
                force_detect_context=True,
            )
            payload: dict[str, Any] = {
                "mode": mode,
                "redacted_text": spliced["redacted_text"],
                "spans": masked,
                "detected_spans_count": len(spans),
                "redacted_spans_count": len(spliced["redacted_spans"]),
                "error": None,
                "trace_safe_preview": safe_trace,
            }
            if mode == "detect_with_allowlist":
                # Allowlisted values were explicitly approved by the user and stay in clear text.
                payload["retained_spans"] = spliced["retained_spans"]
            return Message(text=json.dumps(payload, indent=2))

        if isinstance(raw_val, (dict, list)):
            return Message(text=json.dumps(raw_val, indent=2))
        return Message(text=str(plain_text_result(raw_val) or ""))

    def run_telemetry(self) -> Data:
        plan = self._build_plan()
        return Data(
            data={
                "ai_function": "AI_REDACT",
                "namespace": "DIRECT_AI_REDACT",
                "active_role": LIVE_BRIDGE.active_role,
                "mode": plan["mode"],
                "sql_mode": plan["sql_mode"],
                "supported_categories": list(SUPPORTED_AI_REDACT_CATEGORIES),
                "selected_categories": plan["categories"],
                "estimated_tokens": plan["estimated_tokens"],
                "max_input_output_tokens": SnowflakeAIRedactEngine.MAX_INPUT_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
                "max_output_tokens": SnowflakeAIRedactEngine.MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
                "exceeds_4096_limit": plan["exceeds_4096_limit"],
                "chunked": plan["chunked"],
                "pre_conversion": plan.get("pre_conversion"),
                "session_setup_sql": plan["session_setup_sql"],
                "token_count_sql": plan["token_count_sql"],
                "sql_preview": plan["sql"],
                "disclaimer": AI_REDACT_LIMITATIONS_DISCLAIMER,
            }
        )

            parse_document_mode=getattr(self, "parse_document_mode", "LAYOUT") or "LAYOUT",
            parse_document_page_split=bool(getattr(self, "parse_document_page_split", False)),
            embed_model=getattr(self, "embed_model", "snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0") or "snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0",
            multi_embed_options_json=getattr(self, "multi_embed_options_json", "") or "",
        )

    def run_ai_function(self) -> Message:
        stmt = self._build_sql()
        res = _flow_component_execute_sql(stmt)
        if not res.get("ok"):
            raise ValueError(res.get("message", f"{self.ai_function} execution failed"))
        rows = res.get("rows", [])
        if bool(getattr(self, "batch_directory_mode", False)):
            return Message(text=json.dumps({"rows": rows, "count": len(rows)}, indent=2))
        raw_val = plain_text_result(rows[0].get("RESULT") if rows else "")
        return Message(text=str(raw_val) if not isinstance(raw_val, (dict, list)) else json.dumps(raw_val))

    def to_toolkit(self) -> list[Any]:
        """Tool Mode: one tool named after the configured AI function; the LLM supplies only the input text."""
        fn = str(self.ai_function or "AI_CLASSIFY").strip().upper()
        cfg = str(getattr(self, "categories_or_schema", "") or "").strip()

        def _invoke(input_text: str = "", **kwargs: Any) -> str:
            text = input_text or kwargs.get("tool_input") or kwargs.get("text") or ""
            if not str(text).strip():
                raise ValueError(f"{fn} tool call without input_text")
            self.input_text = str(text)
            return str(self.run_ai_function().text)

        return [
            build_structured_tool(
                name=f"snowflake_{fn.lower()}",
                description=(
                    f"Run the Snowflake Cortex AI function {fn} on the given text under the active Snowflake role."
                    + (f" Configured categories / schema / instruction: {cfg}." if cfg else "")
                ),
                func=_invoke,
                args_schema=AIFunctionToolSchema,
                metadata={"component": "SnowflakeAIFunction", "ai_function": fn, "tool_mode": True},
            )
        ]

    def run_telemetry(self) -> Data:
        return Data(
            data={
                "ai_function": self.ai_function,
                "namespace": "DIRECT_AI_*",
                "active_role": LIVE_BRIDGE.active_role,
                "return_as_json": bool(getattr(self, "return_as_json", False)),
                "batch_directory_mode": bool(getattr(self, "batch_directory_mode", False)),
                "stage_selector": getattr(self, "stage_selector", "") or "",
                "stage_file_path": getattr(self, "stage_file_path", "") or "",
                "sql_preview": self._build_sql(),
            }
        )

from lfx.utils.mustache_security import validate_mustache_template


class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name: str = "Prompt Template"
    description: str = "Create a prompt template with dynamic variables."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-prompts"
    icon = "prompts"
    trace_type = "prompt"
    name = "Prompt Template"

    inputs = [
        PromptInput(name="template", display_name="Template"),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_double_brackets",
            display_name="Use Double Brackets",
            value=False,
            advanced=True,
            info="Use {{variable}} syntax instead of {variable}.",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="tool_placeholder",
            display_name="Tool Placeholder",
            tool_mode=True,
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
            info="A placeholder input for tool mode.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Prompt", name="prompt", method="build_prompt"),
    ]

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None) -> dotdict:
        """Update the template field type based on the selected mode."""
        if field_name == "use_double_brackets":
            # Change the template field type based on mode
            is_mustache = field_value is True
            if is_mustache:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.MUSTACHE_PROMPT.value
            else:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.PROMPT.value

            # Re-process the template to update variables when mode changes
            template_value = build_config.get("template", {}).get("value", "")
            if template_value:
                # Ensure custom_fields is properly initialized
                if "custom_fields" not in build_config:
                    build_config["custom_fields"] = {}

                # Clean up fields from the OLD mode before processing with NEW mode
                # This ensures we don't keep fields with wrong syntax even if validation fails
                old_custom_fields = build_config["custom_fields"].get("template", [])
                for old_field in list(old_custom_fields):
                    # Remove the field from custom_fields and template
                    if old_field in old_custom_fields:
                        old_custom_fields.remove(old_field)
                    build_config.pop(old_field, None)

                # Try to process template with new mode to add new variables
                # If validation fails, at least we cleaned up old fields
                try:
                    # Validate mustache templates for security
                    if is_mustache:
                        validate_mustache_template(template_value)

                    # Re-process template with new mode to add new variables
                    _ = process_prompt_template(
                        template=template_value,
                        name="template",
                        custom_fields=build_config["custom_fields"],
                        frontend_node_template=build_config,
                        is_mustache=is_mustache,
                    )
                except ValueError as e:
                    # If validation fails, we still updated the mode and cleaned old fields
                    # User will see error when they try to save
                    logger.debug("Template validation failed during mode switch", exc_info=e)
        return build_config

    async def build_prompt(self) -> Message:
        use_double_brackets = self.use_double_brackets if hasattr(self, "use_double_brackets") else False
        template_format = "mustache" if use_double_brackets else "f-string"
        prompt = await Message.from_template_and_variables(template_format=template_format, **self._attributes)
        self.status = prompt.text
        return prompt

    def _update_template(self, frontend_node: dict):
        prompt_template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(prompt_template)

            custom_fields = frontend_node["custom_fields"]
            frontend_node_template = frontend_node["template"]
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=prompt_template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=custom_fields,
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node_template,
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be created
            logger.debug("Template validation failed in _update_template", exc_info=e)
        return frontend_node

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """This function is called after the code validation is done."""
        frontend_node = await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)
        template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(template)

            # Kept it duplicated for backwards compatibility
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=frontend_node["custom_fields"],
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node["template"],
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be updated
            logger.debug("Template validation failed in update_frontend_node", exc_info=e)
        # Now that template is updated, we need to grab any values that were set in the current_frontend_node
        # and update the frontend_node with those values
        update_template_values(new_template=frontend_node, previous_template=current_frontend_node["template"])
        return frontend_node

    def _get_fallback_input(self, **kwargs):
        return DefaultPromptField(**kwargs)

        label = f"Thread #{tid} — {t_name} ({updated})"
        if label not in opts:
            opts.append(label)
    return opts

        )

            build_config["schema_name"]["options"] = schemas
            cur_sch = build_config["schema_name"].get("value")
            if field_name == "schema_name" and isinstance(field_value, str):
                build_config["schema_name"]["value"] = field_value
            elif schemas and (not cur_sch or (field_name == "database" and cur_sch not in schemas)):
                # Default only an empty field or after the database changed. A stored schema that is not
                # listed now (role or Context changed) is kept, so the run fails clearly instead of
                # silently using another schema.
                build_config["schema_name"]["value"] = schemas[0]
        sch = (
            field_value

                    # Default an empty field, or one whose database or schema was just changed by the user.
                    build_config["cortex_agent"]["value"] = agent_opts[0]
                elif cur_agent and not listed:
                    # Never replace a stored agent with the first option. An agent that is not listed now
                    # (role or Context changed) stays selected and visible, and the run reports the denial.

    def _execute_agent_turn(self, user_message_override: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        db = (getattr(self, "database", "SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW") or "SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW").strip()
        sch = (getattr(self, "schema_name", "CORE") or "CORE").strip()
        agent = (
            getattr(self, "cortex_agent", None)
            or getattr(self, "agent_target", "EXAMPLE_AGENT")
            or "EXAMPLE_AGENT"
        ).strip()
        short_agent = agent.split(".")[-1]
        agent_fqn = f"{db}.{sch}.{short_agent}"
        prompt = (
            user_message_override
            if user_message_override is not None
            else (getattr(self, "user_message", None) or getattr(self, "user_prompt", "") or "Summarize active flow metrics")
        )
        flow_id = _resolve_flow_id(self)  # BUG-A2A-03: no flow => None (RBAC only), never a pseudo flow id
        sess_id = (
            str(getattr(self, "session_id", "") or "").strip()
            or str(getattr(getattr(self, "graph", None), "session_id", "") or "").strip()
            or flow_id
            or "default"
        )
        resume_thread = bool(getattr(self, "resume_thread", True))
        continuity_mode = str(getattr(self, "thread_continuity_mode", "Resume Latest Thread of this Agent") or "Resume Latest Thread of this Agent")
        conv_thread = str(getattr(self, "conversation_thread", "") or "")
        explicit_tid = getattr(self, "thread_id", None)
        explicit_pmid = getattr(self, "parent_message_id", None)
        tool_choice = str(getattr(self, "tool_choice", "auto") or "auto")

        inv = LIVE_BRIDGE.invoke_cortex_agent(
            database=db,
            schema=sch,
            agent_name=short_agent,
            user_message=str(prompt),
            flow_id=flow_id,
            session_id=sess_id,
            resume_thread=resume_thread,
            thread_continuity_mode=continuity_mode,
            conversation_thread=conv_thread,
            thread_id=explicit_tid if str(explicit_tid or "").strip() else None,
            parent_message_id=explicit_pmid if str(explicit_pmid or "").strip() else None,
            tool_choice=tool_choice,
        )
        result_payload = {
            **inv,
            "database": db,
            "schema_name": sch,
            "cortex_agent": agent,
            "agent_target": agent_fqn,
            "discovery_sql": _show_agents_sql(db, sch),
            "rest_endpoint": f"/api/v2/databases/{db}/schemas/{sch}/agents/{short_agent}:run",
            "active_role": inv.get("active_role") or LIVE_BRIDGE.active_role,
            "context_epoch": inv.get("context_epoch", LIVE_BRIDGE.context_epoch),
            "user_message": str(prompt),
            "prompt": str(prompt),
        }
        if not inv.get("ok", True):
            # BUG-CA-13: a failed Cortex Agent call is a component error, not a 200 SUCCESS chat reply.
            code = str(inv.get("error_code") or "CORTEX_AGENT_ERROR")
            self.status = f"{code}: {inv.get('message') or 'Cortex Agent invocation failed'}"
            raise ValueError(self.status)
        self.status = result_payload.get("thread_indicator") or result_payload.get("text") or "Completed"
        return result_payload

    def _turn_cache_key(self) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
        """Everything that defines one agent turn: input, agent/config, thread selection, session, run, role."""
        graph = getattr(self, "graph", None)
        run_id = getattr(graph, "run_id", None) or getattr(graph, "_run_id", None)
        return (
            id(graph) if graph is not None else None,
            str(run_id or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "user_message", "") or getattr(self, "user_prompt", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "session_id", "") or getattr(graph, "session_id", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "database", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "schema_name", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "cortex_agent", "") or getattr(self, "agent_target", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "tool_choice", "") or ""),
            bool(getattr(self, "resume_thread", True)),
            str(getattr(self, "thread_continuity_mode", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "conversation_thread", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "thread_id", "") or ""),
            str(getattr(self, "parent_message_id", "") or ""),
            str(LIVE_BRIDGE.active_role or ""),
            int(LIVE_BRIDGE.context_epoch or 0),
        )

    def _cached_agent_turn(self, port: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """BUG-CA-12: one execution feeds Response and Structured Response of the same turn.

        A cached turn is reused only for an identical turn key and only by an output port that has not
        consumed it yet; a second call to the same port (or any change of input/config/thread/session/run/role)
        always runs a new turn, so a previous turn's response is never returned.
        """
        key = self._turn_cache_key()
        cached = getattr(self, "_cached_turn", None)
        if isinstance(cached, dict) and cached.get("key") == key and port not in cached["ports"]:
            cached["ports"].add(port)
            return cached["payload"]
        payload = self._execute_agent_turn()
        self._cached_turn = {"key": key, "payload": payload, "ports": {port}}
        return payload

    def invoke_agent(self) -> Message:
        payload = self._cached_agent_turn("response")
        return Message(
            text=str(payload.get("text") or ""),
            thread_id=payload.get("thread_id"),
            parent_message_id=payload.get("parent_message_id"),
            assistant_message_id=payload.get("assistant_message_id"),
            agent_fqn=payload.get("agent_fqn"),
        )

    def invoke_agent_structured(self) -> Data:
        payload = self._cached_agent_turn("structured_response")
        return Data(data=payload)

    def to_toolkit(self) -> list[Any]:
        db = (getattr(self, "database", "SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW") or "SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW").strip()
        sch = (getattr(self, "schema_name", "CORE") or "CORE").strip()
        agent = (getattr(self, "cortex_agent", "EXAMPLE_AGENT") or "EXAMPLE_AGENT").strip()
        short_agent = agent.split(".")[-1]
        tool_name = (
            f"cortex_agent_{sanitize_tool_identifier(db)}_"
            f"{sanitize_tool_identifier(sch)}_{sanitize_tool_identifier(short_agent)}"
        )

        def _run_cortex_agent_tool(user_message: str = "", **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
            q = (
                user_message
                or kwargs.get("question")
                or kwargs.get("query")
                or kwargs.get("input")
                or getattr(self, "user_message", "Summarize active flow metrics")
            )
            if isinstance(q, dict):
                q = q.get("user_message") or q.get("question") or q.get("query") or str(q)
            self.user_message = str(q)
            return self._execute_agent_turn(user_message_override=str(q))

        return [
            build_structured_tool(
                name=tool_name,
                description=(
                    f"Invoke Snowflake Cortex Agent ({db}.{sch}.{short_agent}) via "
                    f"/api/v2/databases/{db}/schemas/{sch}/agents/{short_agent}:run with governed Threads API continuity."
                ),
                func=_run_cortex_agent_tool,
                args_schema=CortexAgentToolSchema,
                metadata={
                    "tool_mode": True,
                    "database": db,
                    "schema_name": sch,
                    "cortex_agent": short_agent,
                    "rest_endpoint": f"/api/v2/databases/{db}/schemas/{sch}/agents/{short_agent}:run",
                },
            )
        ]

from typing import Any

import orjson
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) and not self.is_connected_to_chat_input():
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
            # Preserve existing session_id from the incoming message if it exists
            existing_session_id = message.session_id
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
            existing_session_id = None

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        # Preserve session_id from incoming message, or use component/graph session_id
        message.session_id = (
            self.session_id or existing_session_id or (self.graph.session_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None) or ""
        )
        message.context_id = self.context_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        # Store message if needed
        if message.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Set accumulated token usage from all upstream LLM vertices.
        # This must happen AFTER send_message() because streaming captures
        # usage from chunks and would overwrite accumulated totals.
        if hasattr(self, "_vertex") and self._vertex is not None:
            accumulated_usage = self._vertex._accumulate_upstream_token_usage()  # noqa: SLF001
            if accumulated_usage:
                message.properties.usage = accumulated_usage
                if self.should_store_message and message.get_id():
                    message = await self._update_stored_message(message)
                    await self._send_message_event(message, id_=message.get_id())

        self.status = message
        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value, clean_data=clean_data)
